# Module Identifier

## Summary
The `module` half of a code ref: the URL (or realm-relative path) of a
`.gts`/`.ts` module. Together with an export `name` it addresses one
definition — the shape carried by `CodeRefField`.

## Invariants
- Realm modules are addressed without extension; the realm serves source at
  the same URL with the extension.
- `https://cardstack.com/base/…` is a virtual alias the runtime resolves —
  it is not directly fetchable over HTTP; realm servers serve base source
  under `/base/`.
- Relative module identifiers resolve against the referencing document.

## Example
```json
{ "module": "../matrix-concept", "name": "MatrixConcept" }
```
```json
{ "module": "https://cardstack.com/base/spec", "name": "Spec" }
```
Carried as a value by:
```ts
import CodeRefField from 'https://cardstack.com/base/code-ref';
```
